verdict.rationale: Dots is itself an always-on agent, so it fills the MCP client role. Serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role, and nothing in the evidence shows dots running as an MCP server. Its app connectors (Gmail, Drive, GitHub) and its delegation to Codex are client-side or adjacent features and do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
